reason: Calm, clear, and compact on mobile: the best fit for Fieldnotes.
scope: Editorial visual review of unmodified generated static HTML. No functional or accessibility audit is implied.

criteria.briefFit: A quiet home for ideas, retaining Collect and Connect.
criteria.hierarchy: Clarity of the headline, action, and supporting content.
criteria.character: A coherent and distinctive visual identity.

designs.name: Paper & ink
designs.strength: Expressive type gives the quiet brief real warmth.
designs.tradeoff: Tiny mobile copy; decoration overlaps the content.
designs.caption: Paper & ink: expressive and calm, but weaker on mobile legibility.

designs.name: After hours
designs.strength: A bold headline and unmistakable primary action.
designs.tradeoff: Louder mood; card text crowds together at 800px.
designs.caption: After hours: memorable energy, with a crowded desktop card.

designs.name: Studio blue
designs.strength: Numbered sections make the product story easy to scan.
designs.tradeoff: Large feature illustrations lengthen the mobile scroll.
designs.caption: Studio blue: crisp structure, with more scrolling to reach Connect.

designs.name: Soft sage
designs.strength: Calm tone, clear action, compact mobile feature cards.
designs.tradeoff: Less distinctive than the editorial and Swiss directions.
designs.caption: Soft sage: the strongest balance for this quiet, everyday product.

designs.name: Index
designs.strength: Restrained type and stacked cards keep the content clear.
designs.tradeoff: The primary action and tiny labels feel understated.
designs.caption: Index: clear and restrained, but its primary action is easy to overlook.
